notes.title: Version 1.02 is live!
notes.notes:
Hope you're all enjoying exploring the streets of Tokyo! Some quick hotfixes - shout out to Matt From The Awesome Duo on YouTube for reporting these!

Changes
- fixed a bug where salarymen were falling through the catwalk when under the effects of alcohol 🥴
- fixed a certain back alley wall not having a collider, it was causing the player and their salarymen to fall off the map
- several later waves had their spawns facing the wrong direction. Fixed.
- edited several waves to make them more interesting, or to scale the difficulty on a more fun curve!
- added a Coin Gun to wave 5! 楽しい~
